# Generate e2e — TUI double-generation plan_sha256 equality (REQ-010 / hrc).

mkdir $GEN_ROOT/dbl-tui
chmod 0700 $GEN_ROOT/dbl-tui

cp fixtures/smoke-tui-nogit.toml tui-nogit.toml

exec foundry plan --spec tui-nogit.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/dbl-tui/foundry-smoke-tui --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
cp stdout plan_a.json
dump_digest plan_a.json

exec foundry generate --spec tui-nogit.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/dbl-tui/foundry-smoke-tui --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"committed"'
cp stdout gen_a.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_a.json gen_a.json
exists $GEN_ROOT/dbl-tui/foundry-smoke-tui/internal/tui/app.go

rm -rf $GEN_ROOT/dbl-tui/foundry-smoke-tui

exec foundry plan --spec tui-nogit.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/dbl-tui/foundry-smoke-tui --output json
cp stdout plan_b.json

exec foundry generate --spec tui-nogit.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/dbl-tui/foundry-smoke-tui --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
cp stdout gen_b.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_b.json gen_b.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_a.json plan_b.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq gen_a.json gen_b.json
